How should SoundWave process uploaded audio files into HLS streams?

Long image

A

Answer

Use one Catalog consumer on TrackReadyForValidationEvent to validate, probe, and transcode raw audio into HLS segments in one pass.

  1. BucketNotificationConsumer already moves FileMetadata to PendingValidation and publishes TrackReadyForValidationEvent.1
  2. Running Mime-Detective, ffprobe, and ffmpeg in one job avoids downloading 50 MB audio files from RustFS twice.2
  3. Transcoding builds both a full AAC stream (playlist.m3u8) and a 30-second guest preview (preview.m3u8).3
  4. Bounded worker concurrency and a Hangfire stuck-job check protect API CPU and recover crashed runs.4

Applies toPhase 2.3Catalog & SharedKernelHLS

What are the 7 steps inside the processing worker?

Diagram structure
  • Lock TrackFile lock
  • Fetch Raw File fetch
  • Probe Audio? probe
  • Run FFmpeg HLS transcode
  • Upload Segments upload
  • Mark Failed fail
  • Mark Available commit
  • fetch → probe · local file
  • lock → fetch · Processing
  • probe → fail · corrupt
  • probe → transcode · valid
  • transcode → upload · .m3u8 + .ts
  • upload → commit · parallel PUT
  1. Lock TrackFile ↗

    Check idempotency by FileId, set TrackFile.Status = Processing, and record ProcessingStartedAt.

  2. Fetch Raw File ↗

    Stream raw audio from RustFS into an isolated temp folder under Path.GetTempPath().

  3. Probe Audio? ↗

    Check magic bytes with FileMetadataValidator and run ffprobe to read DurationSeconds and codec.

  4. Run FFmpeg HLS ↗

    Encode 192 kbps AAC segments (seg_*.ts), a 30s preview (-t 30), and optional waveform peaks.

  5. Upload Segments ↗

    Upload .ts segments and .m3u8 playlists to RustFS using bounded Parallel.ForEachAsync.

  6. Mark Available ↗

    Save DurationSeconds, mark TrackFile and FileMetadata as Available, and emit TrackReady.

  7. Mark Failed ↗

    Record FailureReason, delete the bad raw S3 object, and always remove the local temp directory.

Which libraries and tools do we need?

LayerTool / PackageStatus in RepoRole in Pipeline
Object StorageAWSSDK.S3 (IObjectStorageService)InstalledStreams raw audio down and uploads .m3u8 / .ts files
Magic BytesMime-Detective (FileMetadataValidator)InstalledRejects spoofed extensions before invoking FFmpeg
MessagingMassTransit + RabbitMQInstalledRoutes TrackReadyForValidationEvent with concurrency limits
Job RecoveryHangfireInstalledRuns recurring check for tracks stuck in Processing over 30 min
Host Binaryffmpeg + ffprobe CLIInstall BinaryProbes audio duration and packages AAC HLS segments
CLI Runner (Option A)CliWrap (NuGet)RecommendedRuns ffmpeg with safe stderr piping and cancellation timeouts
CLI Runner (Option B)System.Diagnostics.ProcessBuilt-inZero dependencies, but requires manual async stream handling
CLI Runner (Option C)FFMpegCore (NuGet)OptionalTyped C# wrapper, less flexible for custom HLS flags
